subject: Checkout blackout during promo window — downtime confirmation & remediation plan
messages:
From: BrightCart Ops <ops@brightcart.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Checkout 503 blackout between 15:47-16:05 PDT (promo window)

Hi Alex —

We experienced a complete checkout failure during our promo spike this afternoon. Between ~15:47 and 16:05 PDT our checkout endpoint returned 503s and many sessions dropped. This correlates with a noticeable revenue impact on our side (estimate attached snapshot). We need confirmation from Redwood that this qualifies as downtime under our SLO and, if eligible, what proportion of monthly credits will be applied.

Requests:
- Immediate confirmation of the outage window (start/end) as seen by Redwood.
- Raw traces and token-level logs for the interval for our SREs to map against client telemetry.
- Proposed credit calculation and next steps for remediation/postmortem.

This is blocking our reconciliation with finance — can you escalate?

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Ops Lead, BrightCart
ops@brightcart.com

Attachment: brightcart-impact-snapshot.pdf (pdf)

Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout 503 blackout between 15:47-16:05 PDT (promo window)

Hi all —

We pulled preliminary telemetry. On our side we see a sharp spike in 503s on route /v1/checkout/complete from 15:47:21 to 16:05:12 PDT (US-WEST-2). Root cause signal points at concurrent prefetch KV eviction causing sustained request failures for some tenants while autoscaler attempted to compensate.

What we can provide now:
- Raw traces + request IDs for 15:46:30–16:06:00 PDT (attached as a packaged stub)
- Tokenization+routing latency histogram for that interval
- A short timeline of internal remediation actions: autoscaler scale-up at 15:55, routing fallback at 15:58, full recovery observed by 16:05.

Attachments: raw-traces-20280530.tar.gz (tar.gz; contains trace_manifest.txt with request ids)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm eligibility against the contract SLO (we need billing window + tenant impact numbers from BrightCart).
2) Propose a provisional prorated credit (we'll draft numbers and circulate).
3) Schedule a technical postmortem (30–45 min) with BrightCart SRE and our infra leads — propose Wed 2028-06-01 09:00 PDT.

Alex — if you want me to send the traces directly to their SRE inbox I can, but please confirm whether we should include a redacted log set for tenant PII.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Credit proposal & postmortem invite — BrightCart checkout blackout (30 May)

Hi Maya / BrightCart team —

Thanks for flagging this. We reviewed the traces Laura provided and reconciled the window against our SLO definition. Summary below: 

- Observed downtime window: 2028-05-30T15:47:21-07:00 to 2028-05-30T16:05:12-07:00 (UTC-7)
- Impact: significant error-rate spike on /v1/checkout/complete for tenant brightcart-prod (multi-regional replication not in play for this route)
- Eligibility: This meets the contractual definition of downtime for the monthly SLO bucket.

Provisional remedy: We propose a prorated credit equivalent to 7.5% of BrightCart's monthly usage for May 2028, calculated as follows: prorated_hours = 18 minutes / (30 days * 24 * 60) => credit fraction applied to token usage charges. Detailed calculation attached (credit-proposal-rc2391.xlsx).

We'd like to schedule a 45-minute post-incident review to go over timeline, root cause (prefetch KV eviction + autoscaler interplay), and remediation actions (improvements to prefetch resilience, autoscaler tuning, and an early-warning runbook). Proposed times:
- Wed 2028-06-01 09:00 PDT (incl. recording) — invite attached
- Fri 2028-06-02 14:00 PDT (backup)

Action items for BrightCart:
- Confirm acceptance of the provisional credit calculation or provide a counter with supporting telemetry.
- Confirm postmortem attendee list and preferred time.
- Advise whether we should issue a formal DocuSign credit memo or an account-level invoice adjustment.

Attachments: credit-proposal-rc2391.xlsx, postmortem-invite-20280601.ics

We aim to finalize the credit within five business days after the postmortem. If you need an expedited billing adjustment sooner, let us know and we'll coordinate with finance.

Regards,
David Kim
Head of Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
